proposal.text:
The saved reply and cleanup are independently verified. You can now try the prototype yourself in a 10-minute session with up to five text messages, using the same ChatGPT/Astra setup and access limits.

Shall I open that session on your Mac? Pairing will be automatic, with shutdown and temporary-credential cleanup at the end.

preparationAuthority: Prepare fresh packet, necessary controller changes, focused synthetic tests, exact pins and cache archival. Preparation must not start the live runtime, pair, enroll or send messages.

scope.messageOrigin: Only the human owner types/sends chosen plain-text messages; the UI operator must send no sample or corrective prompt.
scope.pairing: Automatic local UI pairing; enrollment values remain in non-emitting CUA variables.
scope.readinessHandoff: Immediately after pairing and opening Writer Home, notify the parent with exact workCutoff and credentialExpiry and zero messages sent; leave composer ready for the owner.
scope.cleanup: At work cutoff stop acceptance/dispatch, cancel work, TERM only exact pinned native executable, confirm exit/empty pending, dispose owned runtime/listener, revoke exact service and issued native temporary credentials. Preserve ledger/cache.

acknowledgedLimits: same-user agent host has Mac user access
preservation: All four prior state/ledger/evidence packets unchanged; completed fourth cache archived by exact directory rename with all hashes preserved.
excluded: broader permissions or relaxed startup checks
